title: Appliance Rebates in London 2026: Up to $200 Per Appliance
desc: London, Ontario appliance rebates for 2026: $25 to $200 from Home Renovation Savings, with London Hydro as distributor.
lead: London has 174,655 households, 21% of them in tall buildings, and 42% renting. The appliance page does not limit the rebate by home type.
cards_heading: What Ontario pays for new appliances in London
cards_intro: We re-read the program's appliance page on October 4, 2026. The rebates are province-wide, so the amounts are the same in every city, and the rules about what you replace and which model you buy are what decide a claim.

cards.title: Heat pump clothes dryer
cards.note: The largest of the six appliance rebates, for a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient heat pump dryer replacing an electric dryer.

cards.title: Induction cooktop or range
cards.note: For a new induction cooktop or range on the program's product list, replacing an existing electric one.

cards.title: Washing machine
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient washer on the program list.

cards.title: Fridge
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient refrigerator replacing an existing electric one.

cards.title: Freezer
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient freezer on the list.

cards.title: Dishwasher
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient dishwasher on the list.

cards.title: Who can claim
cards.note: A residential customer on the Ontario grid with an existing electric appliance in need of replacing. Cornwall Electric customers are excluded.

cards.title: Free route
cards.note: Income-qualified households can get energy-efficient fridges and freezers at no charge, along with other upgrades.

after_cards: The appliance page states no end date, so confirm it is still open before you buy.
sections: London has 21% of its households in buildings of five or more storeys, and 10% in smaller apartment buildings. For those households appliance rebates are worth asking about because the page does not name a home type, though it does not mention condos or apartments either.

London Hydro supplies electricity. London postal codes begin with N, which the Energy Affordability Program lists for free fridges and freezers to households under the income limits. January lows average -7.5°C.

Unlike the thermostat rebate, the appliance page lists no home type. It asks for a residential customer on the Ontario grid. It does not address condos or apartments directly, so a London condo owner or tenant should confirm with the program. 42% of London households rent, and a tenant should ask the landlord before swapping a fridge or range that came with the unit.

The six rebates are $200 for a heat pump dryer, $150 for an induction cooktop or range, $75 for a washer, $50 each for a fridge and a freezer and $25 for a dishwasher. A household that replaced all six would receive $550, though few London homes will need to swap everything at once. The rebate is flat, so it takes the same amount off an entry model and a premium one.
Buy new, then upload the receipt

Buy a new appliance from any retailer, then upload the receipt on the program page within 60 days of purchase. Used and refurbished units do not qualify. Keep the receipt, the model number and the delivery date together. London households who buy during a sale should still confirm the model is on the list at the time they check out.
Fridges and freezers at no cost

The Energy Affordability Program lists energy-efficient refrigerators and freezers among the items that comprehensive support can provide, along with LED bulbs, dehumidifiers and window air conditioners. It does not list washers or dryers, and its saving kits include no major appliances. Income limits run from $48,220 for one person to $96,439 for four, and London postal codes are among those it covers. Call 1-844-770-3148 to ask.
claim_steps: Check that the appliance you are replacing is electric and that you are on the Ontario grid.
Find a new model on the program's ENERGY STAR Most Efficient list for that appliance.
Buy it new from any retailer and keep the receipt.
Upload the receipt on the program page within 60 days of purchase.
If your household income is under the limits, call 1-844-770-3148 about free fridges and freezers first.
